name: dbt-kb-checks
description: Behaviors backing dbt KB claims, verified with dbt-core 1.11.15 + dbt-postgres 1.11.0 on a scratch project assembled from the KB snippets (dbt parse offline; dbt build against a local Postgres 16.2 from the pgserver wheel, no Docker)

cases.description: Pinned versions resolve on Python 3.12 and dbt_utils range installs
Project assembled from KB snippets parses without warnings
generate_schema_name_for_env override resolves schemas per target
cases.input: dbt parse --target dev|prod; read node.schema from manifest.json
cases.expected: dev: all nodes in dbt_dev; prod: stg_* staging, dim_*/fct_* marts, snapshot snapshots, seed staging

cases.description: env_var without default fails when unset
cases.expected: Parsing Error: Env var required but not provided: 'DBT_USER'

cases.description: Top-level generic test arguments are deprecated
Same model described in two YAML files
cases.input: models: [{name: stg_erp__produtos}] in a second properties file
cases.expected: Compilation Error: dbt found two schema.yml entries for the same resource

cases.description: state:modified selects a changed model offline
cases.input: cp target/manifest.json state/; edit stg_erp__produtos; dbt ls -s state:modified+ --state state --resource-type model

cases.description: Full project builds and tests on Postgres
cases.expected: PASS=46 (1 seed, 1 snapshot, 3 views, 4 tables incl. the table variant of fct_vendas as fct_vendas_simples, 1 incremental, 35 data tests, 1 unit test)

cases.description: Incremental unit test with input: this on a fresh database
cases.input: dbt build on an empty schema
cases.expected: unit test ERROR: relation fct_vendas doesn't exist; dbt run --empty fails (snapshot not built); dbt build --empty --exclude-resource-type unit_test then dbt build -> PASS=48

cases.description: --empty rewrites ref() into an aliased subquery
cases.input: from {{ ref('stg_erp__vendas') }} as v ; dbt run --empty
cases.expected: syntax error at or near "as"; import-CTE style works

cases.description: Snapshot + SCD2 dim + point-in-time fact join
cases.input: raw.clientes id=10 uf SP -> RJ at 2025-03-01; dbt build
cases.expected: 2 versions in dim_clientes; Jan sale -> SP version, Mar sale -> RJ version

cases.description: delete+insert incremental replaces updated rows and adds new ones
cases.input: update raw.vendas id=2 quantidade 5; insert id=4; dbt build -s fct_vendas
cases.expected: fct_vendas id=2 quantidade 5, id=4 present, no duplicates (unique test PASS)
merge into ... as DBT_INTERNAL_DEST; status MERGE 2

cases.input: raw.vendas _loaded_at = now() - 10h; warn_after 6h; dbt source freshness -s source:erp.vendas

cases.expected: snap row id=11 gets dbt_valid_to = snapshot timestamp

cases.description: persist_docs writes doc block text as Postgres comments

cases.input: data_tests: +store_failures: false in dbt_project.yml, then dbt test --store-failures; remove it and rerun --target dev|prod
cases.expected: explicit config wins (no audit table); without it: dev -> dbt_dev.<test>, prod -> dbt_test__audit.<test>
